title: sandbox_call auto-adds Idempotency-Key when omitted, preventing literal no-header verification
actual: Calling sandbox_call POST /infection/waste/handover without idempotency_key generates a sandbox-* key. The real response is the expected 409 WASTE_HANDED_OVER, but this cannot establish behaviour without the header.
expected: Provide an explicit documented way for sandbox_call to omit Idempotency-Key for negative tests. No frontend or waste runtime defect is alleged; same-key replay and final-note conflict passed.
steps: Current fresh run SCN-7429acf-mw3mdv03: create synthetic collections, hand over with original key, replay original key, then invoke the same body with no idempotency_key argument. Inspect the tool's request.idempotency_key.
